description: Ministry of Lands - Mrs. N. B. I. Nanayakkara as a Land Acquiring Officer
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with a land acquisition matter. It specifically appoints an officer for the purpose of expediting land acquisitions for the Weras Ganga Storm Water Drainage and Environment Improvement Project under the Land Acquisition Act. While it mentions a government minister and makes an appointment, the core subject matter is land acquisition, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related administrative matters.
